Forward EV

Forward EV is a charging network offering Destination, and En-route charging. As of the end of August 2026 Forward EV had a total of 104 EV chargers across the UK.

Forward EV is an independent, host-owned public charging network delivering destination chargers across the UK. For drivers, this means you can expect to find their devices at handy local stop-offs like Yaxley Service Station, Caenby Corner Garage, The Cottage Hotel, and Golden Days Garden Centre. Because the local business fully owns the hardware, pricing is set independently by the host, so it's a great idea to check the Zapmap app before arriving to view the current live tariff and charger availability.
